notes.title: Turbo Kid Patch v.1.0.118196
notes.content:
Howdy, Wastelanders!

We've been busy fixing bugs!

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] In the [spoiler]Last GG Crate[/spoiler] cutscene, we reduced the loot spray radius so that the dialog isn't interrupted when picking them up.
[*] Adjusted the spacing between elements in the credits to make dividers seamless.
[*] Improved framerate in the credits.
[*] Reduced the rrrrrrrrrrrumble on [spoiler]Mecha preacher[/spoiler] coming out of the floor.
[*] In the [spoiler]escape sequence[/spoiler], an alarm now plays when the flashing red lights start instead of when the countdown starts.
[*] All NPC icons in the map are now linked to the appropriate journal page with the More Info button.
[*] Updated the "More Info" button color in the map menu.
[*] Updated credits and various fixes for missing characters and funky display bugs in various languages.
[*] Added support for Japanese and Chinese.
[/list]


[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] In the [spoiler]Last GG Crate[/spoiler] cutscene, we fixed an issue where running to the left immediately after [spoiler]destroying the big GG crate[/spoiler] would not complete an objective.
[*] In that same cutscene, fixed instructions not disappearing when walking away from Naomi and restarting the dialogue.
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial prompt didnèt fully update when switching language in-game.
[*] Fixed some camera snapping in the crouching passage in the [spoiler]Junkyard[/spoiler].
[*] In the settings UI, both the game and main settings menus were using the teal-colored "back" button for the notebook. Switched it back to the regular ivory one.
[*] Fixed the Buzzsaws at the bottom of [spoiler]Becca's pit[/spoiler] from going idle when going too high.
[*] In the tutorial, fixed TK's dialogue disappearing if the player walks to the left of the tutorial level.
[*] Fixed the map icon for the door to the [spoiler]mall in the junkyard[/spoiler] being off.
[*] In the [spoiler]Skatepark[/spoiler], we fixed a fidgety camera when moving back and forth between McSpeedy and the starting zone.
[*] Fixed issues with [spoiler]races[/spoilers] not raising their flags in the [spoiler]Wasteland, Sewers and Junkyard[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed the second pending reward not being handed out when returning to see the NPC after having already finished a [spoiler]race[/spoiler] once.
[*] Fixed missing animations for [spoiler]Pappagallo, Silver Ghost, Max and Nestor[/spoiler] in the [spoiler]ending at the gates[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed a missing message when opening the notebook or map with the keyboard while a game controller was active and a speech interaction prompt or dialogue UI was displayed and returning to the game.
[*] ✨Potential✨ fix for the player who had the trap door close on him before he could get in it in the Cutscene with the [spoiler]Witch[/spoiler]. You know who you are, player! Shout out for reporting bugs! 😎
[*] Added some missing links to notebook entries.
[*] Fixed titles not being visible in the controller button assignment and video mode confirmation pop ups.
[/list]

notes.title: ㄒㄩ尺乃ㄖ Ҝ丨ᗪ ㄩ卩ᗪ卂ㄒ乇 ᐯ.1.0.117736
notes.content:
Listen carefully, kid. Remember the weird symbols and sightings we've spotted across the wasteland in the past weeks and no one could figure out what it was all about? Well, there's a new visitor in the Wastes, somewhere.. I have a hunch they know something. 👀

What are you waiting for? Grab your helmet and your bike and go! There's a mystery to uncover!

[previewyoutube=RQOjSr_K3Y8;full][/previewyoutube]

Besides this intriguing, otherworldly mystery, this update also contains multiple fixes and improvements!

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]A new mystery awaits Turbo Kid in the wastelands.. Questions will be answered!
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Multiple improvements related to performance and physics.
[*] Various work done in preparation for consoles upport.
[*] [spoiler]Hogarth's[/spoiler] first description is now displayed when speaking to him before completing the [spoiler]Scramblers[/spoiler] quest.
[*] Balanced the required times, scores and rewards for multiple Minigames.
[*] The Minigame panel remains displayed when completing an arena until the reward is collected.
[*] Rebalanced the [spoiler]Arena[/spoiler] by slightly decreasing the amount of enemies and acid.
[*] Improved map scroll with the keyboard by adding acceleration.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Objects or behaviors are now properly activated or deactivated depending on player distance.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Minigame reward wasn't giving scraps anymore.
[*] Fixed the [spoiler]Singularist Thug[/spoiler] speaking with bubbles instead of quips.
[*] The text concerning [spoiler]Hogarth and his secret passage[/spoiler] that appears after the [spoiler]Scramblers' ceremony[/spoiler] will now only show up if the player has already spoken to [spoiler]Hogarth[/spoiler].
[*] The extra dialogue for [spoiler]Naomi[/spoiler] after getting a [spoiler]weapon chip[/spoiler] will now only ever be shown once.
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Hogarth[/spoiler] calling you an [spoiler]honorary Scrambler[/spoiler] before finishing the quest.
[*] Game now checks if [spoiler]Return to Scramblers HQ[/spoiler] objective is complete before [spoiler]Hogarth[/spoiler] lets you pass.
[*] [spoiler]Paddy on the Ramp of Judgement[/spoiler] now restarts her dialogue if the player rudely moves away while she's talking! Poor [spoiler]Paddy[/spoiler] :(
[*] The weapon icon now updates if your lack of mana autoswitches you to the standard [spoiler]Turbo Blaster[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed typos and line break issues in French.
[/list]

Whew! That's all for today! Be sure to hop on our [url=https://turbokid.gg/discord]Discord server[/url] and let us know what you think (or just to say hello, or to share some dank memes, however the mood strikes you!)

notes.title: Turbo Kid Patch v.1.0.117279
notes.content:
Hey hey HEY! We're back with another update, kids! 🔥

Turbo Kid will be part of a few digital festivals soon, we'll have news for you. Until then, be sure to leave a review and tell your besties and favorite creators about the game, it helps a ton! 🙏

Without further ado, let's dive right into today's patch notes. Keep the bug reports and suggestions coming!

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a restart button to the Arena and Bike Tricks mini games.
[*] Multiple tweaks and improvements to most of the boss fights.
[*] New animation for the energy bar when getting an upgrade.
[*] Improved texts in the menus.
[*] Added a Discord button to the main menu. (Join us! [url=https://turbokid.gg/discord]https://turbokid.gg/discord[/url] )
[*] Improved the auto-rotation on the bike so it's harder to fall when not using any tilts.
[*] Added Naomi on the west side of the [spoiler]Skatepark[/spoiler] to give you the zone intro if you arrive by the [spoiler]Junkyard teleporter[/spoiler]
[*] When the player runs out of [spoiler]Turbo Energy[/spoiler], the weapon is now automatically switched to the basic gun.
[*] Tweaked the way scraps are displayed in the HUD: added scrap no longer decreases as the bank increases to help players better understand how much scrap is collected.
[*] Updated localization for keyboard inputs.
[*] Made the keyboard key instructions in the tutorial clearer.
[*] Delayed the minimap appearing at the start of the game to improve the intro.
[*] You can now save after completing a [spoiler]bike race minigame[/spoiler] but before getting the reward.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/eb2914001daf963e40a0073d52809fcf2ca4be70.jpg[/img]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The [spoiler]Drone Spider[/spoiler] now only shoots from the top instead of glitch out when the visual controller is disabled.
[*] Adjusted the [spoiler]Oozinator[/spoiler] arm position.
[*] Stopped the [spoiler]Saw gun[/spoiler] projectile from bouncing if the last hit destroys the target.
[*] Fixed players being able to switch tabs even when a popup was displayed in the settings menu.
[*] Tweaked some steel beams that were too difficult to grab.
[*] Improved the performance on the scraps system.
[*] Fixed an issue that stopped players going down ladder if they were partially on it and partially on solid ground.
[*] The [spoiler]Flying head spawner[/spoiler] was sometimes leaving the light on when destroyed.
[*] Instructions for new weapons were displaying keyboard instructions instead of controller instructions when needed.
[*] Fixed an issue where [spoiler]Becca and Witch[/spoiler] would disappear after [spoiler]defeating Becca[/spoiler] if the player moved far enough for them to be off-screen.
[*] Added a missing [spoiler]Lighting gate switch[/spoiler] to the map in the [spoiler]Skatepark.[/spoiler]
[*] Shooting while emoting was sometimes causing the animation transition to get stuck for a few seconds. Can y'all stop finding weird ways to break the game pls?? (but if you do anyways let us know)
[*] Fixed some weirdness when trying to do tricks while both wheels were still on the floor.
[*] Fixed an issue where bosses starting cutscenes would be skipped if the player died once during the current session.
[*] Changed "Issac" to "Isaac". Our bad, dude.
[*] Pressing back in the assist menu would sometimes close the whole menu.
[*] [spoiler]Shivers[/spoiler] would sometimes keep prompting you with "Y" when you finished his quest.
[*] The [spoiler]Destroy GG reserves[/spoiler] objective was being completed too soon.
[*] Removed the random "Daddy!" dialog bubble that came out of nowhere in a cutscene.
[*] Updated the German translation of "Cartridge". Thank you to those who reported this!
[*] [spoiler]Naomi[/spoiler] would sometimes trigger the [spoiler]Junkyard's[/spoiler] intro cutscene even if the player has already been there.
[*] The cutscene where [spoiler]Naomi prays in the Church[/spoiler] would sometimes trigger even if the player was already past that point.
[/list]

There we go! Hope you've been enjoying Turbo Kid and keep the feedback and love coming! Have a great week-end. 🤘

notes.title: Turbo Kid Patch v1.0.117105
notes.content:

We've been watching ALL the streams and Youtube videos (no really, obsessively looking out for them! Be sure to post any and all Turbo Kid content on our Discord server) and it's been great seeing how everyone is enjoying Turbo Kid - it's great feedback too!

If you haven't yet, consider dropping the game a review on Steam, it helps a ton! 🙏

ANYWAYS, today's patch is pretty HUGE! Here's the deets:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new quest to unlock more [spoiler]teleports[/spoiler]! That's all we'll say for now. 👀 Happy turtle hunting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/1995dfcd902b592e5fb77d528dc65082629e70d3.jpg[/img]

[*] Added an energy tutorial video when the player gets his first weapon.
[*] Added a pulsing effect to certain hint texts to better catch the player's eye.
[*] Added a heavy jingle sound effect to the weapon beam.
[*] Changed the sound effect of the loot sensor. It's lootier now.
[*] Added the option to Restart Minigame in the menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/a2688a96ccad8bb9eba9ba465def4bee827be924.jpg[/img]

It's been a great week since launch and we're so, SO thankful for the support! Please keep talking about Turbo Kid to your friends, favorite streamers and whoever's willing to listen!

If you haven't yet, remember to leave a review, it helps tremendously. 🙏

We just released a patch with tons of fixes and polish. Here are the deets;

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new tutorial video for the cartridge menu.
[*]Added an arrow at the start of the race in the cliffs to help players with an initial direction.
[*]Updated the conditions that made Naomi's huge crate unintentionally respawn.
[*]Improved the flow & UI of the Cartridge system.
[*]Darkened the tutorial doors to improve the ~vibe~.
[*]Improved the [spoiler]Junkyard race[/spoiler] with new arrows, checkpoints positioning and obstacles. Go try it again!
[*]Improved the timed switches visuals with smol lights and wires that go to the door as a visual cue.
[*]Renamed the section below the church in New Haven to "Cliffs Subsection" to avoid confusion.
[*]Improved the display of multiple entries that had too much vertical space reserved.
[*]Localized and fixed some credits entries.
[*][spoiler]Morha[/spoiler]'s dialogue was improved and will now suggest [spoiler]staying for ANOTHER lesson after the player has seen at least one.[/spoiler]
[*]Added spikes to prevent some sneaky Turbo Kids from seeing the cut in the ceiling in the [spoiler]Cliffs[/spoiler].
[*]Moved [spoiler]Collectible Tales[/spoiler] from the [spoiler]Basement[/spoiler] to the [spoiler]Skatepark Vent[/spoiler].
[*]Forced to-do subsections to start on the left hand pages for consistency.
[*]Tweaked the Out of Bounds time from 10 to 8 in races.
[*]Increased the trigger shape for pickupable items (it's a real word I Googled it)
[*]Improved the visuals for the bike skin stand so that they're better in Naomi's Lab Container.
[*]Multiple improvements to [spoiler]the Jimmy quests[/spoiler] with dialogues, map icons adjustments and other tweaks to make it clearer.
[*]Made the [spoiler]Silverghost[/spoiler] fire longer and is removed as soon as [spoiler]the teddy is destroyed[/spoiler].

[*]Corrected multiple syntax mistakes.
[*]Fixed an issue where Naomi's note in the prologue was readable more than once.
[*]Fixed an issue where an unloaded room could be seen in the corner of the screen in the Basement.

[*]Removed Herobrine.

notes.title: Development Update February 21
notes.content:
Whaaaat's up Wastelanders!

We know you've been itching for some Turbo Kid gameplay and you better strap your brain buckets on because we've got some exciting things to share with you today! 🤘

[h1]IGN Fan Fest 2024! 🎉[/h1]
Turbo Kid's new trailer was just showcased exclusively on IGN Fan Fest 2024! We're thrilled (and a little jittery!) for the opportunity to show off the game to such a big audience. Check out the event featuring our rad new trailer below! 

[previewyoutube=qk6ac4gHFdY;full][/previewyoutube]

And for those of you who are a bit more bloodthirsty, here's the RedBand trailer with more gore:

[previewyoutube=L4d86gLdMDI;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't wait for more and more people to join our awesome community and give us feedback for the ... 🥁 drumroll! 🥁


[h1].. New Demo! 🎮[/h1]
It's almost here! This Friday, you can finally play a brand new Turbo Kid demo! 🚲 It's jampacked with updated art, level design, NPCs, and of course, incredible music from Le Matos, the very same composer that rocked the music in the movie! Download the demo on February 23 for a fresh glimpse into the gritty wasteland and to freshen up your biking skills!

Check it out right here on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733250/Turbo_Kid/]Steam page[/url] this Friday!

We would love to hear your feedback on the demo once you've had a chance to play it, so be sure to hop on our [url=https://discord.gg/YaDd6A5fMJ]Discord server[/url] and let us know what you think.

[h1]Release Date[/h1]
This is it, kids. We're in the final stretch! We're happy to announce the release date of Turbo Kid officially! The game will launch on Steam for PC everywhere in the world.

[h3]🚀 April 10th 2024! 🚀[/h3]

As for the Switch release, we are still hard at work to make the best port possible and we should release it shortly after the Steam launch. We'll be sure to update you as soon as we have a release date.

It's been such an exciting time developing this game! Turbo Kid is a cult classic movie we absolutely love. We wanted to take all the time we needed to make a game that not only lives up to the standards of the movie's following but also an all-around rad Metroidvania anyone can enjoy!

The Wasteland will be filled to the brim with life and things for you to discover; NPCs, biomes, landmarks, enemies, boss fights, challenges, collectibles, secrets.. so many secrets.. and much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/5f340498ff0796605f9d290e2021fa21d0a47417.png[/img]

We're eternally grateful for your support throughout the development and we can't wait for you to play the full game. But until then, be sure to enjoy the new demo, we think you'll love it!

Until next time, stay rad.

notes.title: Development Update - March-April 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Well, hello again Turbo Kids,[/h1]

Ready for another dev update? This one features what we’ve been up to since February, so it’ll be a bit less massive than the last one, but still lots of stuff to cover. Here we go, round 2!

[h2]Cartridges[/h2]
Remember these collectibles from the demo?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/056593edb0f5f49b34ab222412289b5bf3e6af4d.gif[/img]
Shiny AND useful

They’re called “Cartridges” and are much more than some simple shiny trinkets to add to your collection. You will be able to equip cartridges to gain passive boosts like bonus damage or resistance, attracting loot around you and even modifying existing traversal skills. You’ll have a limited number of slots to equip cartridges, though, so choose wisely. Here’s a preview of the upcoming cartridges screen, with absolutely no hints to other sub-screens included. Also note that cartridge icons are not representative of final art just yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/9084f965f7adfed47681e3c1227117857f4b76d3.png[/img]
Nothing else to see on this screen, just cartridges, only cartridges.

Weapons & Energy
Turbo Kid is a Metroidvania, as such, one might expect it will feature quite a few upgrades & powers to unlock. One might be right. These will include weapons, all kinds of weapons. The most observant among you may have noticed the mysterious blue bar under your health bar which expands when you collect a certain item that looks like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/c39ea50146d595c2ec801ba8cad83d60497ded84.gif[/img]
May or may not contain Mutagen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/b6a59a8d4f857addf278757782e5338684ff2756.png[/img]
So mysterious. Oh, the many secrets it holds.

That bar represents the energy you can use when firing special weapons. We have put a lot of work into making energy collection and use fun, and encouraging using different types of weapons. “Enough talk, when do we get to see the weapons?!” you might say. Unfortunately, I’m not here to spoil the fun of discovering these new weapons, but I can show you what happens when you collect one. Take a look at this beauty:

[previewyoutube=DW9GPx_TvYE;full][/previewyoutube]
By the power of the Wasteland, I HAVE THE POWER!

[h2]Other progress[/h2]
Many other big features are in the works but they aren’t quite ready to showcase yet. Nevertheless, here’s a small sample of other things currently in development.

[h3]Junkyard & Sewer Boss Fights[/h3]
We’ve made a lot of progress on these two boss fights and our QA and designers (and many other curious members of the team) are thoroughly testing them.

[h3]Gameplay & Accessibility Settings[/h3]
We’ve added more settings, including new gameplay (bike options) and control settings (hold vs. toggle), and a set of options for “assist mode”. Assist mode settings are simple adjustments to modify the experience and better suit your needs or preferences. Examples include modifying health or loot drop odds and modifying defense or damage.

[h3]Notebook[/h3]
Another big feature currently in progress: the Notebook. This is where you’ll keep track of your adventures throughout the game. It will contain details on locations you visited, characters you’ve encountered, your current objectives, and all of your collectibles. It’s a pretty big feature and work will be ongoing for some time so expect more info on this in upcoming updates.

[h3]Visual Effects[/h3]
We’ve been putting a lot of work into visual effects, both for in-game and for UI (menus) to capture that signature retro look and feel. Final touches are being added to all manner of feedback in-game, including weapons, collectibles, damage, etc. We’ll dive into this in the next update, lots of eye-candy upcoming.

[h2]What Next?[/h2]
That is it for this edition: progress on multiple fronts, and lots of big features currently in the works. I hope you all enjoyed the update, and I’m already hyped for the next one. As always, you can stay up to date on all developments regarding Turbo Kid by joining our community:

[url=https://linktr.ee/outerminds]Outerminds | Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Twitch | Linktree[/url]

Cheers!

Ray—Lead Programmer for Turbo Kid

notes.title: Development Update - February 2023
notes.content:
Hey there Turbo Kids,

We've been pretty busy here at Outerminds, working hard on Turbo Kid. We thought it would be fun to update you all on what we have been up to since the release of the Steam Demo. Not only that, but these updates will become a monthly occurrence from now on. Let’s dive in, shall we?

[h1]Brand New Zones[/h1]

[h2]Sewers[/h2]
If you caught some of our streams, you may have seen a little preview of this new zone. The Sewers have their own unique atmosphere, lots of cool lore and colorful characters to interact with, some new enemies and challenges to tackle and, of course, a new Boss Fight: Oozinator. ***May or may not include super-powered turtles with headbands.***
Here’s a quick look at some of this new content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/b662d2ed357383d26ca40396d13c9539fdea6606.png[/img]
The lovely, inviting and not at all deadly, Sewers

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/0f11796fd4b8bb99900a90920f3ffa49da6721fb.gif[/img]
Possibly worse than hospital Jell-O

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/ab6f54184162c042d5740d5981c19675f2efa573.gif[/img]
Just your regular human doing regular human things

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/1e23d2e9667322c53a2815c8c658b973e2a8b4df.gif[/img]
Even more annoying than real flies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/7ca5e8e63f0779fe10cfcb0df47850d23767d7fb.gif[/img]
…probably something they ate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/0d42a55e34c97b285789e7aedfe4383e5f540b52.gif[/img]
Piñatas, but the deadly kind

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/f45c1a2f305c30f790d648d284f9e0ad93e21d09.png[/img]
Boss: Oozinator, maybe they just want a hug

[h2]Junkyard[/h2]
Work has also begun on other zones within the game. One of these is the Junkyard, a really desolate populated mostly by robots and drones. Be ready for a wide variety of challenging enemies, and an even more challenging Boss Fight. Keep an eye out, someone’s junk can often be someone else’s treasure (or killer robot).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/ffd2fa3fc8b34bd2c264ada62b2ad8d5ab16b448.gif[/img]
Flying drones: Ouch

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/69b47cdc5cd27826b5d864d0157e5c753f8b55f0.gif[/img]
Turrets: Also ouch

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/bf75f98484457629e718ffdd6a774bb38249db41.gif[/img]
Driller Drones: Surprise ouch

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/c22fecfb9f8bb490dd84aaf5cf347149aff4bfca.gif[/img]
Boss: Silver Ghost, she’s quite the scrapper

[h2]Wasteland[/h2]
This area connects everything together, it's also where your journey will begin. It features picturesque landscapes, lots of mysteries and lore to discover and some rather unique enemies. The perfect place to listen to some kickass music from Le Matos while riding around on your bike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/93163ca66dbe38018b55d5fcc4ef22044ef28823.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/16b35419ee120ded6e68a2cf05e1b5bcf0753725.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/ff4c2c9fbc3c2f3878b1aa32a27ebd3ff7f3039e.gif[/img]


[h1]New Features & Upgrades[/h1]
We’ve also been working on lots of cool new stuff to make your experience as memorable and enjoyable as possible. From quality of life improvements to brand new features, here’s a quick breakdown of all the shiny new things.

[h2]Skippable Dialogues, Cutscenes & NPC Improvements[/h2]

One of the most requested features from the Steam Demo was the ability to skip dialogues. This is a crucial feature for speedrunners and less narratively inclined players. Practice your speed-reading techniques or blaze through previously explored areas without wasting those valuable seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/e1cb6c9fead48d2808689372097e3242ad7fdfdc.gif[/img]
Skippable dialogues: For players on the go

We followed this improvement up with a rework of existing cutscenes and NPC interactions. This includes text streamlining, timing adjustments, clearer dialogues and a few more background characters chiming in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/d0ad6104d83f06c8b889c7fcdab768474b91f7e4.png[/img]
That’s some good life advice right there, free of charge

[h2]Fast-Travel System[/h2]
You may have noticed the world we have built for you to explore is quite expansive. While you do have your trusty bike to zip around on, sometimes you need something faster to travel vast distances, some sort of “system” that would allow you to “travel” “fast”... 
Introducing the Fast-Travel System! You will find many of these fast-travel pods scattered across the world to allow you to quickly get from Point A to Point B, C, D… and so on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/fad4be0d8e8425f409716d239fa60b9d66060b11.gif[/img]
Fast-Travel Pods: Also for players on the go, but much faster

[h2]File Selection[/h2]
Players will now have 3 save slots to choose from when starting a game. Pretty useful if you want a different save game for your speedrunning practice or your Apple playthrough. Save files will display a bunch of important info, like playtime, progression % and unlocked weapons to help you keep track of everything. It also comes with the always handy “copy” and “delete” functionalities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/0497a024fdb2b41bc7e97808b4029ff80c9669f4.gif[/img]
File selection screen: Organizational skills not included

[h2]Gameplay Settings & Controls Remapping[/h2]
We added a bunch of new gameplay settings to help you customize your Turbo Kid experience to your liking. This includes a planned feature that we sadly didn’t have time to put into the demo, but is now finally here: Controls Remapping. So if you desperately want to map “Jump” to the “Scroll Lock” key on your keyboard, or the “Left Trigger” on your controller, who are we to stop you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/d50e5e931c2a12e8487a5bbecb8605a8bc8ff9ad.gif[/img]
Controller Mapping: you tell that controller who’s boss

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/ad467fcc055091845e0521ae1569ea1cf532afb9.gif[/img]
Keyboard Mapping: That “M” key was clearly under utilized

[h2]Merchant Shops[/h2]
If you played the Demo you may be wondering what all those scraps you collect are for.  Merchant Shops! You can now exchange your “scraps” for some nice rewards like health or energy upgrades and maybe even some cartridges (more on those in next month’s update).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/c5d33d62f595345447b23b30c918068424fc0493.gif[/img]
Can’t you just imagine all the nice things this person will have for sale?
 
[h1]Kickstarter content[/h1]
Last but not least, Kickstarter stretch goal content is constantly being added.

[h2]Hall of Corpses[/h2]
The “Hall of Corpses” is ready to welcome you with its impressive display of varied corpses, as described very “creatively” by our imaginative backers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/55f25959c56718bba07603a1e6eb7320ef168c9d.png[/img]
Uncensored content in all its gory pixelated detail available in-game only

[h2]Apple[/h2]
Apple has also made her appearance in the game. With over 425 unique animations for our protagonist characters, our artists are always hard at work making sure Apple looks her very best. We even have dynamic hair physics when she is riding her bike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347770/8d9f05a811460af9d66c65abe7c1214d6e64966b.gif[/img]
Apple: BMX Pro
 
[h1]Next Update Coming Soon[/h1]

That’s it for this month! We hope you enjoyed this sneak peek. There’s so much more to discover in-game, including many Easter eggs and other secrets we can’t reveal quite yet. Our next update will be coming soon, make sure you don’t miss it by joining our community:
https://linktr.ee/outerminds

See you in the Wasteland!
 
Ray - Lead Programmer on Turbo Kid

notes.title: A New Year, A New Update, A Playable Apple
notes.content:
[b]Happy New Year everyone![/b]

The team here at Outerminds is back in full force after a fun holiday and we’re ready to give you a little idea of what 2023 has in store for us as well as a much-needed update to confirm we’re still breathing. ;)
To start, we’d like to address some of the more frequently asked questions we’ve seen in comments and on social media:


[b]Q.[/b] We know the game will be released for Switch and Steam, but will it be available on other platforms?
[b]A.[/b] The only two platforms are still Switch and Steam. Plans to launch on other platforms remain unchanged as of now. We will be sure to update you if these plans change.

[b]Q.[/b] When can we expect the physical version and physical bonuses?
[b]A.[/b] Physical editions of Turbo Kid as well as Kickstarter backer bonus items will be delivered on or after our release date, this will all depend on shipping providers. We’ll have more info to share as we near launch.
If you haven’t already, please take a look at the Kickstarter FAQ tab as these questions have been addressed when we first set up the page. If amendments are ever required, you will be the first to know.


[b]Regarding development[/b]

2023 is our year and we’re confident that we’ll deliver a totally rad, totally chrome, version of the game.
Content is well on its way to being created and you can learn all about our smaller achievements and progress updates via our Turbo Kid YouTube streams. If you’ve got questions, that’s the best time to ask live! We’ll also make sure to keep you updated as much as we can on Discord.


[b]Q.[/b] The arrow keys aren’t the best for controlling the bike. Can you please add a key-mapping option?
[b]A.[/b] Absolutely! The full release of the game will include the ability to map your keys wherever you want them to be.


[b]Regarding the Steam Demo[/b]

If you haven’t noticed, we put up a Steam Demo of a tiny gameplay portion for Turbo Kid back in later September/Early October. This is the best way to get a feel for the eventual release, bop to some Le Matos tracks and commit gory destruction.


[b]Q. [/b]Will the demo stay forever?
[b]A.[/b] Yes!
 Or at least, until the apocalypse.

[b]Q.[/b] Will you update the demo?
[b]A.[/b] No! We’re concentrating all our manpower on the full release of the game, but don’t hesitate to leave feedback on the demo page, we’re happy to have a conversation on game design or whatever you fancy.


[b]Looking over the wasteland’s horizon[/b]

With that, thank you again for your continued support and we can’t wait to keep the conversation going.
In the meantime, here’s what you’re actually here for, early looks at playable Apple in Turbo Kid.
